subject: NETWORKING
title: [PLACEHOLDER] Networking Basic: monthly assessment
note: Sample questions for testing. Replace them with questions approved by the Networking practice head before go-live.

questions.text: Which device forwards frames between devices on the same LAN using MAC addresses?
Which device connects different IP networks and chooses paths between them?
Match each device or medium to the OSI layer where it mainly works.
questions.explanation: Cables carry signals (layer 1), switches forward frames by MAC address (layer 2), and routers forward packets by IP address (layer 3).

questions.text: A VLAN lets one physical switch carry several separate logical networks.
How many usable host addresses are there in a /24 IPv4 subnet?
Which of these are private IPv4 address ranges? Select all that apply.
What does DHCP do?
options: Assigns IP addresses and settings to devices automatically
correct: Assigns IP addresses and settings to devices automatically

questions.text: The service that translates domain names such as intranet.example into IP addresses is called ____.
questions.explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) resolves names to addresses.

questions.text: PoE (Power over Ethernet) lets a switch power devices such as access points and IP phones over the data cable.
What is the maximum recommended length of a Cat6 copper horizontal run in structured cabling?
Which Wi-Fi standard is also known as Wi-Fi 6?
Which questions help size a wireless network for a customer site? Select all that apply.
options: How many users and devices per area?
What is the floor plan and wall construction?
Which applications will run, such as video calls?
What is the customer's favourite colour?
correct: How many users and devices per area?
What is the floor plan and wall construction?
Which applications will run, such as video calls?

questions.text: What is the main benefit of SD-WAN over traditional MPLS-only WAN?
options: It removes the need for any internet link
It can steer traffic across several link types by application policy
It works only inside one building
correct: It can steer traffic across several link types by application policy

questions.text: A static route is learned automatically from neighbouring routers.
Which protocol is used to stop loops in a switched network?
What does a managed switch offer that an unmanaged switch does not?
options: Configuration such as VLANs, monitoring, and QoS
correct: Configuration such as VLANs, monitoring, and QoS

questions.scenario: A customer has two buildings on one campus, 400 metres apart. They want a 10 Gbps link between the server room in building A and the floor switches in building B.
questions.text: Which cabling should the proposal include for this link?
questions.explanation: Copper twisted pair is limited to about 100 metres per run; fibre carries 10 Gbps over hundreds of metres or more.

questions.text: QoS (Quality of Service) can give voice and video traffic priority over bulk downloads.
Which items belong in a structured cabling handover pack? Select all that apply.
options: Test results for each cable run
correct: Test results for each cable run
